title: fix(types,core): the 5xx fault log and ObjectLogger print an error's cause chain
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgNK8fscnDPTKcJygoa9kFqB)_
Fixes #37598
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；服务器出 5xx 故障时，运维日志里那一行现在会带上被包在里面的原始错误（原因链），不用再猜真正的故障在哪。
- 为什么做：记录 AI 问询专题里一张跟进卡，上一张把“关联记录读取失败”改成故障后，日志里看不到底层原因，只能临时把原因拼进堆栈绕开；这次在日志本身补上，绕开的写法一并拿掉。
- 出错会怎样：只影响服务器日志的内容，接口返回给用户的内容一个字节不变；有问题撤回本次合并即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/types/src/server-fault-log.ts`: new `faultCauseChain(thrown)` returns the `cause` chain under a thrown value, outermost first, each link `{ message, stack? }` (`message` is `Name: text` for an `Error`, the text itself for a string cause, JSON for an object cause). Bounded at `FAULT_CAUSE_DEPTH_LIMIT` (5) links and cycle-safe (stops at the first repeat); either cut ends in a marker link that says so. A throwing `cause` getter ends the chain instead of costing the line. `logServerFault`'s console fallback (the sink `sendError` / `sendServerFault` and every un-wired door reach) now writes `causes` beside `stack`. The injected-logger branch is unchanged: it hands the logger the thrown error with its `cause` intact, and the logger renders it, so the chain is never printed twice.
- `packages/core/src/logger.ts`: `ObjectLogger.write` records an error as `{ message, stack, causes? }` (was `{ message, stack }`), same bounds and same shape, for every `logger.error` / `logger.fatal` that passes an `Error`. Field is absent when there is no cause.
- Both copies: a link whose read throws (a hostile `name` / `message` / `stack` getter, a Proxy) ends the chain in a marker link (`[cause chain link unreadable: reading it threw]`) instead of costing the line or the record.
- One helper or two: two copies, pinned to one output. `core` already depends on `types`, but `@objectstack/core/logger` is the browser-safe entry `@objectstack/client` bundles, and `client` does not depend on `@objectstack/types`; importing it would pull the `types` root (and `@objectstack/spec` value imports behind it) into the browser logger. `logger-error-cause.test.ts` runs eleven fixtures through both and asserts equal output.
- `packages/services/service-record-context/src/record-context-tools.ts`: drops the `Caused by:` suffix PR #37550 appended to a failed related read's stack (and its now-unused `describeThrown`). The original still rides on `cause`, which the fault line now prints.
- Wire: no response body changes. The fault line is operator-only.
- Changeset `.changeset/37598-fault-log-cause-chain.md` (patch: `@objectstack/types`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/service-record-context`).

Read first: `faultCauseChain` and the console branch of `logServerFault` in `server-fault-log.ts`; `renderError` in `logger.ts`.

## Tests

- `packages/types/src/server-fault-log-cause.test.ts` (15): console fallback logs each cause's message and stack (wrapper → mid → root); CONTROL no cause ⇒ no `causes`; a declared capability absence (warn) carries none; cycle and self-cause stop with a marker; a 20-deep chain stops at 5 plus a marker; string and object causes; a throwing getter; a link whose message read throws ends in a marker and the line is still written; a cause is redacted like the error (an object cause, by whole words as the logger matches its redact list, inside an array in an object cause, and on the console fallback line); an injected logger receives the error with `cause` intact and no `causes` in meta; `sendServerFault`'s body carries no cause text while its line carries the root.
- `packages/core/src/logger-error-cause.test.ts` (18): JSON record carries `error.causes` for `error` and `fatal`; CONTROL no cause; cycle; deep chain; a cause is redacted like the error (under a configured `redact` list); a link whose message read throws ends in a marker and the record is still written; parity with `faultCauseChain` over eleven fixtures (nested Error, cycle, deep chain, string cause, object cause, a cause redacted like the error, field names under the default redact words whole-word matched, an array inside an object cause, an object cause that cannot be serialized, a link whose message read throws, a throwing `cause` getter).
- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts`: the real-kernel outage case now finds the original as `causes[0]` (`Error: OUTAGE`, stack carrying it) on all four fault lines, the stack carries no `Caused by:`, and the answer text on both doors carries no cause text.
- `packages/services/service-record-context/src/__tests__/record-context-tools.test.ts`: the suffix pin now asserts `cause` is the original and the stack carries no `Caused by:`.
- Ablation (the console branch's `causes` spread disabled, rebuilt, marker proved in `dist/`): `server-fault-log-cause.test.ts` 2 failed / 8 passed (the two that read the chain off the line), the runtime harness outage case failed (`causes[0].message` undefined). Restored (blob = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker absent from `dist/`): 10/10 and 28/28.

## Acceptance notes

- A test per sink with a nested cause, cycle and deep chain bounded: `server-fault-log-cause.test.ts`, `logger-error-cause.test.ts`.
- The record-context harness outage case still finds the original in the fault line with the suffix removed: `mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts`.
- No response body change: pinned in the harness (both doors) and in `sendServerFault`'s case.
- Noted, not filed: `@objectstack/observability`'s `ConsoleLogger` / `JsonLogger` (the other `Logger` implementations) still record an error as `{ error, stack }` without its `cause` (`loggers.ts` lines 56 and 114 on this head); outside the claim's surface, and carried by #37658.

## Rework (contract review 7200020944, seat REWORK 7200035097)

- M1: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` in this body and the changeset (three new exports on `@objectstack/types`: `faultCauseChain`, `FAULT_CAUSE_DEPTH_LIMIT`, `FaultCauseLine`); every package stays at `patch`.
- S1: fixed as the area relayed; pinned by the tests named "a cause is redacted like the error" in both packages.
- S2: each link is guarded in both copies; the case is in the parity fixtures and in each package's own tests.
- S3: the observability loggers are carried by #37658.
- N1: both docblocks name `logger-error-cause.test.ts`.

Second delta (contract review 7200840843 PASS, seat REWORK 7200856706):

- S4: the console fallback's default field-name rule is now `ObjectLogger`'s own whole-word matcher (the #5573 rule) over the same default words, copied beside `faultCauseChain`; a parity fixture of the spellings that differ (`keys`, `tokens`, `monkey`, `keyword`, `secretary`, `apiKey`, `apikey`, `accesstoken`, `refresh_tokens`, `clientSecret`, `API_KEY`) fails on any drift. Drift check: with the fallback put back to a substring match and rebuilt, that fixture went red (1 failed / 17 passed); restored (blob = HEAD), 18/18.
- N2: the `faultCauseChain` docblock says the fallback applies only the default words, never a host's own `redact` list.
- N3: an array inside an object cause is pinned in both packages and in the parity fixtures.
- Handing the MCP doors the kernel logger is out of scope; the area files it.

## Verification

- Local: see the report for the head, the targeted suites, each touched package's whole suite and typecheck, and the derived gate families.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/types exec vitest run --project local src/server-fault-log-cause.test.ts`, expected 10 passed.
